from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]))
    div_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in div_rows]
    row_ends = div_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in div_cols]
    col_ends = div_cols + [w]
    cells = [[(rs, re, cs, ce) for cs, ce in zip(col_starts, col_ends)]
             for rs, re in zip(row_starts, row_ends)]
    # The nonempty tile away from the first column contains the shape to reproduce.
    pattern = None
    tile_h = tile_w = None
    for ri, row_cells in enumerate(cells):
        for ci, (rs, re, cs, ce) in enumerate(row_cells):
            if ci == 0:
                continue
            coords = [(r-rs, c-cs) for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if coords:
                pattern = coords
                tile_h, tile_w = re-rs, ce-cs
                break
        if pattern is not None:
            break
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in div_rows:
        out[r] = [sep] * w
    for c in div_cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = sep
    for ri, row_cells in enumerate(cells):
        rs, re, cs0, ce0 = row_cells[0]
        colors = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs0, ce0) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        color = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
        for rs, re, cs, ce in row_cells:
            for dr, dc in pattern:
                if dr < re-rs and dc < ce-cs:
                    out[rs+dr][cs+dc] = color
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-80ec235d.py'
path.write_text(program)
print(path)
